quality.review_scope: All thirteen supplied main pages read in full and visually inspected, with independent source and canonical scientific audits. SI not located or verified. General synthesis routes, analytical procedures, source model parameters and observation cohorts remain separate; records do not assert independent physical batches.
missing_fields: Matching supporting information not located or verified.
No sample-resolved atomic coordinates or fully refined core/shell interface structure supplied.
No reliable mean size for high-coverage samples; estimated upper sizes are discussed without numerical table.
Equal electron-density approximation incurs author-estimated10–15% error; fits/model quantities are not exact experimental labels.

Figure12caption gives high-coverage sample d sigma0.25 whileprose says reliable high-coverage mean/variance extraction is not meaningful.
